description: 20260729_TE80_IRVE_TIRUERT is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Territoire d'Energie Somme. Ce jeu de données recense les infrastructures de recharge pour véhicules électriques (IRVE) exploitées par Territoire d'Énergie Somme (TE80), syndicat d'énergie du département de la Somme. Les données concernent exclusivement les points de charge équipés d'un compteur MID (Measuring Instruments Directive), correspondant aux infrastructures déployées à partir de 2023. Coverage: Territoire d'Energie Somme. The publisher named on the listing is Territoire d'Energie Somme. Its keywords include mobilite-electrique, territoire-energie-somme, te80, borne-de-recharge-electrique, compteur-mid, hauts-de-france. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
